resolved_findings.resolution: Response uses actual finite station surfaces, unequal spacings and explicit missing-hit rejection, rather than ideal capped-cylinder crossings.
Separate barrel/disk alignment and native z/r precision projections are explicit; solenoid bending is not credited as equally precise MDT information.

Replaced inadequate50mm outlines by provisional500mm full-chamber reservations; extended toroids and disk positions to provide real axial room. Actual normal extrusions replace spurious isotropic depth inflation. Internals remain undesigned.

limitations_and_open_gates.effect: HCAL steel grade/B-H response and complete supports are missing. Vacuum superposition cannot certify the installed nonlinear map, installed energy or full-system engineering compliance.

48.1A/mm2 barrel winding-pack density is a separate unqualified conductor assumption; cited ATLAS conductor does not fit. Turns/current, peak conductor field, critical margin, forces, quench, pressure vessel, services and cold supports remain unqualified.

The complete vacuum U/V closes a proposed global unique geometric allocation. It is not per-coil energy-density, mass, stress or quench certification. Empirical energy refinement changes are not rigorous uncertainty bounds.

Straight local500GeV rays, independent Gaussian station errors and uniform1.3X0 are analytical proxies. No chamber internals, nonlinear-material transport, energy-loss fluctuations, reconstructed efficiency, backgrounds or correlated tracker-muon fit were simulated. Finite eta/phi scans are not continuum guarantees or solid-angle-weighted efficiencies.

The reported grid errors are sampled; cancellation and near-coil regions still require direct/refined evaluation. Momentum proxies use direct fields and omit interpolation/field uncertainty. An additional20point tracker check found solenoid96-to192 axial refinement difference up to1.235mT(0.0408percent), distinct from interpolation error.

Normal-extrusion guard is conservative; interstation path sampling is at most10mm and can miss arbitrary grazing intersections. No native DD4hep/Geant4 solid navigator, material or overlap qualification was run. PNG drawing visual QA was not independently repeated in this physics review.
